scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/chatgpt-web build && bun run --cwd packages/proxy-lib build && bun run --cwd packages/proxy build && bun run --cwd packages/openclaw-plugin build
scripts.build:libs: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/chatgpt-web build && bun run --cwd packages/proxy-lib build
scripts.test:unit: bun run build:libs && bun run vitest run
scripts.test:live: bun run build:libs && M365_LIVE=1 bun run vitest run
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/chatgpt-web && tsc --noEmit -p packages/proxy-lib && tsc --noEmit -p packages/proxy
